{{Quote|I probably shouldn't be telling you this, but Captain Donovan was piloting this ship and I want to know what happened to him.|[[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />}}
'''Donovan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I do not know where I am. I was at another camp after they hijacked my ship. Then they moved me here. They have me shackled so I cannot escape.|Captain Donovan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Donovan was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Captain Donovan was delivering weapons to the local CorSec force in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] when his ship was hijacked by the criminals known as the [[Deflarians]].<ref name="SWG:DC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Deflarian Cleanup|Corellia}}</ref> Donovan himself was captured and imprisoned in the [[Deflarian bunker]].<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> The Deflarians then crashed a ship of the same model than Donovan's to cover the theft of the cargo.<ref name="SWG:DC" /> CorSec [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] was tasked by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jark]] to lead the investigation. Cora hired a spacer who managed to find the location of the bunker. The spacer infiltrated the bunker and found the imprisoned Captain Donovan. The spacer therefore killed [[Vinros]], several Deflarian henchmen and a Deflarian underboss to free Donovan.<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> Captain Jark later discovered that Donovan was betrayed by a CorSec agent, [[Jori]], who sold Donovan's flight schedule to the Deflarians.<ref name="SWG:LtBB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Let the Buyer Beware|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Donovan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Donovan was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
